name: Menitrazepam
summary: Menitrazepam is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative. It is similar in structure to tetrazepam and nimetazepam, with the 7-chloro group of tetrazepam replaced by nitro. It is a hypnotic agent used in the treatment of insomnia, and therefore has strong sedative, anticonvulsant, muscle relaxant, and anxiolytic actions like those of other hypnotic benzodiazepines.

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, muscle relaxation, poor coordination, memory loss and confusion. Like other benzodiazepines, regular use can lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures. Too much can dangerously slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡、肌肉放鬆、協調變差、失憶與混亂。和其他苯二氮平類一樣，經常使用可能導致依賴，長期使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷，包括癲癇發作。過量可能使呼吸危險地減慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡、肌肉放松、协调制差、失忆与混乱。和其他苯二氮平类一样，经常使用可能导致依赖，长期使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断，包括癫痫发作。过量可能使呼吸危险地减慢。

fact.en: Menitrazepam is tetrazepam with a nitro group in place of the chlorine, and like tetrazepam it has a cyclohexenyl ring where most benzodiazepines carry a benzene ring.
fact.zh: Menitrazepam 是把四氫西泮的氯換成硝基，而且和四氫西泮一樣，在多數苯二氮平類接苯環的位置上接的是環己烯基。
fact.zhHans: Menitrazepam 是把四氢西泮的氯换成硝基，而且和四氢西泮一样，在多数苯二氮平类接苯环的位置上接的是环己烯基。
